Userspace core extension, based on ppp-project/ppp pppd 2.5.5
commit 4dc474cacfa045d1ee1b10c388d8c864e3ed3b30.

LCP: original negotiation callbacks and Echo/RTT state, timer and wire algorithms
are retained. The previous authentication-disabling macros and Echo stubs are
removed. Windows options are configured explicitly by the host instead of using
the Unix option table. Malformed short incoming Echo-Requests are rejected before
writing a Magic Number. Multilink, endpoint and LQR remain disabled because no
matching data/backend is implemented. RTT file I/O replaces Unix mmap with a
native FILE-backed buffer; the original 8192-byte network-order ring format and
measurement calculations are retained. The engine supplies monotonic timestamps
and real packet counters for adaptive Echo.

IPCP: original negotiation callbacks are retained, with original address
consistency and authorization checks restored at the UP transition. Windows
receives negotiated DNS/WINS and addresses via real host callbacks. Unix scripts,
resolv.conf, proxy ARP and direct route manipulations are not copied. VJ negotiation now connects to the Linux VJ userspace codec in vj_port.c.

IPv6CP and EUI64: original init/open/close/lowerup/lowerdown/input/protrej/resetci,
CI length/add/ack/nak/rej/request/finished and text-formatting routines are
retained. Original UP checks for missing or equal interface identifiers are
retained. Linux demand and interface syscalls are replaced with explicit Windows
host callbacks. IPv6 compression is disabled. Persistent hardware-derived IDs
and Unix scripts are not advertised without a corresponding backend.

engine.c: existing native async framing and host adapter are extended to dispatch
the original authentication and IPv6CP code, gate IPv4 and IPv6 independently,
support the upstream MRU ceiling 16384, and configure retained FSM parameters.
Authentication must complete before any network protocol starts. Idle and
maximum-connect timeout decisions follow auth.c, using host activity timestamps
instead of Linux get_idle_time. The 0.4.0 data path adds upstream CCP and userspace adaptations of the Linux VJ, BSD, Deflate and MPPE codecs. Multilink remains absent.

The historical 0.3 adaptation used work/extend_core.py and the pinned original
source archive. The delivered 0.4 C sources are the build inputs; its subsequent
CCP/data-host adaptations are described by CCP-PROVENANCE.json and codec manifests.
Original source and header notices are preserved in every retained file.
